meta.title: Events & Workshops | Take 3 Agency
meta.description: Workshops and one-off sessions from Take 3 Agency for dancers, SPACTs, models and specialist performers. Book and pay for your place online.
meta.ogDescription: Workshops and one-off sessions for performers, booked and paid for online.

hero.heading: Workshops and one-off sessions.
hero.lede: Practical sessions run by the desk that books the work, with people who do it every day. Some are open to everyone; the members' workshops need the access code sent to artists on the roster.

listing.heading: Coming up
listing.emptyNote: Nothing on the calendar just now. New sessions are announced to the roster first.

event.checkoutNote: You will get a receipt by email straight away, and the joining details about a week before the session.
event.bookingIntro: Payment is taken securely by Stripe. You will get a receipt by email straight away, and the details of the day a week before.
event.membersIntro: This workshop is for artists on the Take 3 roster who have been offered a place. Enter the access code from your email to continue to payment, which is taken securely by Stripe.
event.codeHint: Sent to you by email with your offer of a place. Contact us if you have not received it.
event.attendeeHint: As it should appear on the register.
event.emailHint: Your receipt and the joining details go here.
event.soldOutNote: Every place is taken. Email us and we will let you know if one comes free.
event.closedNote: Bookings for this session have closed.
event.notConnectedNote: Online booking is not switched on yet. Email us to reserve a place in the meantime.

errors.code: That access code was not recognised. Check your invitation and try again.
errors.full: Sorry, the last places went while you were on this page.
errors.quantity: You can book between one and four places at a time.
errors.config: Online booking is not available right now. Please email us to reserve a place.
errors.stripe: Payment could not be started. Please try again, or email us to reserve a place.

event.applyIntro: Places on this workshop are awarded by application, not first come, first served. Applications are read by the workshop leader and the Take 3 team, and successful applicants are sent a code to secure their place.
event.applyClosedNote: Applications have now closed. Successful applicants have been sent their access code.
event.acceptedIntro: Enter the access code from your acceptance email to pay for your place. Payment is taken securely by Stripe and you will get a receipt straight away.

booked.title: Booking confirmed | Take 3 Agency
booked.heading: You're on the list.
booked.lede: Thank you. Your place is confirmed and a receipt is on its way to
booked.ledeNoEmail: Thank you. Your place is confirmed and a receipt is on its way to you.
booked.whatNextBody: We will send the joining details, including where to meet and what to bring, about a week before the session. If anything changes on your side, reply to the receipt email and we will sort it.
booked.missingHeading: We could not find that booking.
booked.missingBody: If you have just paid, your receipt from Stripe is the confirmation. If you are unsure whether the payment went through, email us before trying again.
